title: C15 skritek
prompt: Medium shot inside a dark armory with tall racks of swords, spears and shields, one small sneaky grey-skinned goblin imp with long pointed ears and a wicked grin crouches on top of a rack and pours a glowing bright orange chaos potion over the weapons, the swords and spears melt, bend and crack with glowing orange chaos, orange smoke and crackling orange lightning, orange sparks. Background: cold dark teal stone armory, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.
